subject.title: Feature: Private Mode for demos and content creation

question: What threat model and activation surface should Private/Secret/Incognito sessions guarantee before implementation?
rationale: The source gap spans protocol, session persistence, memory/context, channel triggers, tools/media, and UI, so automation cannot safely choose the privacy boundary without maintainer intent.

options.title: Per-session private mode first
options.body: Add an additive per-session private/ephemeral contract with UI indicator and tests proving no durable history or memory/context persistence for that session.

options.title: Channel default plus command trigger
options.body: Design per-channel defaults and commands such as /private at the same time, accepting larger channel-specific semantics work before implementation.

options.title: Defer as out of scope
options.body: Keep current context-injection and manual deletion/pruning controls as the supported alternative, leaving no strict no-persist mode.

recommendation.title: Per-session private mode first
recommendation.body: Add an additive per-session private/ephemeral contract with UI indicator and tests proving no durable history or memory/context persistence for that session.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete already handled the substantive maintainer review for this canonical tracker and is the clearest owner for the product/security boundary decision.
